title: Case ledger update
description: A model's reading of case comments not yet in the case ledger, as the arguments of its ledger_update call: what each comment asks, commits to, reports or provides, and which earlier items a new comment settles, supersedes or withdraws. Every item cites the comment it comes from, and every change the later comment that makes it, by the name the request gave it. A reading, never verified fact and never evidence (docs/MODEL_API.md §The case ledger).

none.description: The comments given that hold nothing to record, each with why, so every comment read is accounted for: by an item, a change it makes, or here.

comment.description: A comment by the name the request gave it, such as e12.

item.description: One thing a comment asks, commits to, reports or provides, in one line, citing the comment. An ask is open until a later comment answers or rules it out; a commitment pending until a later comment shows it done or dropped; what was provided stands until a later comment supersedes it.

due.description: For a commitment, when it was promised by, as the comment says it.

attachment.description: For what was provided, the attachment as the comment names it.

status.description: An ask open, or answered or ruled out by a later comment among those given; a commitment pending, or done or dropped by one; what was provided none, or superseded by one; a report none. A settled or superseded status names that later comment in because.

none.description: A comment that holds nothing to record: courtesy (thanks, greetings), automated (a system's message), a repeat of an earlier comment, or nothing new otherwise.

update.description: A change to an item the ledger holds, by its ID, which a later comment makes: an ask answered or ruled out, a commitment done or dropped, what was provided superseded by a newer capture asked for or sent or by a report that the state it captured is gone; or any item withdrawn, because an edited version of its own comment no longer says it.
